label: TP
reason:
User input from 'param' (derived from request parameter) flows directly into the HTML response via string concatenation ('Welcome back: '+user+'
') without any HTML entity encoding or context-aware escaping. The conditional check '(7*42)-num>200' evaluates to false (252-86=166 which is not >200), so the potentially safe constant string is never used, and the vulnerable user-supplied value reaches the sink.

evidence.note: User input assigned to 'bar' variable based on condition that always fails, then concatenated into response writer without sanitization.
Condition (7*42)-num > 200 evaluates to false (166 > 200 is false), ensuring 'bar' receives untrusted user input instead of safe constant.
